Market Selloff Hits Financial Stocks. Why Banks, Brokerages Are Caught in the Crossfire.
Shares of financial services companies as varied as Robinhood, Webull, Goldman Sachs, and Morgan Stanley fell sharply on Thursday.
Individual investors dumped financial stocks on Thursday, dragging down shares of major brokerage firms and banks such as Robinhood, Webull, and other companies.
